subject: Next steps: vendor questionnaire & evidence needs for Securimed
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@securimed.com>
Cc: procurement@securimed.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: questionnaire path and timeline

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement side: 

1) High-level compliance posture we covered
- SOC 2: in progress (Type II expected Q4 2028) — we can share the SOC 2 Type I report and the control matrix now.
- HIPAA: support via BAA (we have a standing BAA template) — we can execute with your legal team.
- GDPR: standard DPA available; we support EU region hosting via dedicated tenancy if needed.

2) Questionnaire routing
- You mentioned CAIQ as the preferred form but there are a few custom fields in your intake. To avoid duplicate work, can you confirm whether you prefer: (A) standard CAIQ + a 1-page addendum for the custom items, or (B) SIG-prefill from our side and you validate?

3) Evidence & timeline
- If CAIQ + addendum: we'll return a prefilled CAIQ within 5 business days and attach SOC 2 Type I and our KMS diagram.
- If you want SIG-prefill: we'll need a 48–72 hour window and Marissa (cc'd) will own evidence mapping.

Action items for Alex / Securimed: please reply with your preferred questionnaire path (CAIQ vs SIG-prefill), the primary security contact for evidence exchange, and any hard procurement deadlines you have.

I attached a lightweight SIG prefill template (redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx) to show the minimal set we fill in up-front. Happy to set a quick handoff call with Marissa and Priyom to go through evidence ownership.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment stubs: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (Excel; SIG prefill example)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@securimed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@securimed.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: questionnaire path and timeline

Thanks, Sean — helpful recap. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying questions: 

Preferred path: CAIQ + small custom addendum. Procurement wants the CAIQ filled first; our InfoSec team will then push back on any addendum items. If it's straightforward we can accept a 1-page addendum; if it's not, we'll escalate to a short follow-up RFI.

Contacts: 
- Primary security contact: me (Alex Turner) for intake and clarifications.
- Technical evidence owner: legal@securimed.com (they centralize vendor paperwork).

Clarifying asks: 
- SOC 2: you mentioned Type I available — can you confirm the audit date and whether any gaps were noted? We may need the control matrix as evidence.
- KMS / key management: do you use a customer-managed KMS option or only Redwood-managed keys? We need to know if CMEK is available for PHI workloads.
- Data residency: our production data must remain in us-west-2. Is that supported for a dedicated deployment?

Timeline: procurement would like a completed CAIQ prefilling within 7 business days if possible. I've attached our standard vendor intake workbook (securimed_vendor_intake.xlsx) that lists a few custom fields we routinely require.

Thanks — if Marissa or Priyom want to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to review the intake workbook, I'm available 10–11am or 2–4pm PT.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement & InfoSec, Securimed
alex.turner@securimed.com
Attachment stubs: securimed_vendor_intake.xlsx (vendor intake workbook)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@securimed.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: questionnaire path and timeline

Alex — thanks for the clarity and the intake workbook. Brief internal note and proposed approach from security: 

1) SOC 2 evidence
- We will provide the SOC 2 Type I report (audit date: 2027-11-15) plus our control matrix. No major gaps flagged in the Type I; Type II run is scheduled for Nov 2028.

2) KMS / keys
- Default deployment: Redwood-managed keys (AES-256). We do offer a CMEK option for Dedicated customers on an enterprise contract. For PHI/BAA use we recommend Dedicated + CMEK. If Securimed intends to process PHI, please flag that so we can route to Solutions for pricing.

3) Data residency
- US-West-2 is supported for Dedicated reservations. For Hosted accounts we can pin region for most deployments but Dedicated guarantees tenancy.

Suggested plan (to hit your 7-business-day target):
- Option A (CAIQ + addendum): Sean will send CAIQ prefill by EOD Wed (48 hours). Marissa / Priyom will attach SOC 2 Type I + control matrix. We will call out CMEK availability in the addendum.
- Option B (SIG-prefill): we can do a focused SIG-prefill within 72 hours but that may overlap with your procurement workflow.

Ready to run a 30-min handoff with Alex and procurement tomorrow at 10:30am PT if that works — we can walk the workbook and mark which answers require engineering/legal artifacts.

Action: Alex, confirm 10:30am PT or propose another slot. If you confirm, I'll send calendar invite and an agenda (30 min, goals: agree on CAIQ path, confirm evidence owners, identify any showstoppers).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
